sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Light Value-Added Postponement Packaging and Custom Kitting

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation), Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT obligations), Decree 1068 of 2015 (SARLAFT framework), DIAN Resolution 164 of 2021 (final beneficiary reporting), Superintendencia de Sociedades External Circular 2019-05, and Decree 830 of 2021 (UBO register under National Tax and Customs Administration).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing of the foreign parent shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the origin state is a Convention member; otherwise Consular Legalization by the Colombian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney appointing the local representative for incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization if the origin state is not a Convention member)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn source-of-funds statement and PEP/sanctions declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian notary with subsequent chamber registration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarial authentication; no apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all direct shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council sanctions lists, Colombian UIAF and DIAN watchlists, and national judicial measures. Enhanced due diligence applies to politically exposed persons (PEPs), including foreign and domestic PEPs, in accordance with Colombian SARLAFT regulations and UIAF Circular 004 of 2019.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) through the local Cámara de Comercio, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish or in Latin characters accepted by the registry; the proposed name may include numbers, ampersand, periods, and must end with the designator 'S.A.S.'. Names must avoid illegal, misleading, or socially sensitive terms, and must not duplicate an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a reconsideration appeal with the same Cámara de Comercio under Law 1437 of 2011 (Código de Procedimiento Administrativo). The appeal must be submitted within ten business days of notification; the chamber then has fifteen business days to confirm or modify the decision. If rejected again, the applicant may initiate judicial review before the Consejo de Estado.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a low-risk administrative 3PL kitting operation provided that a physical address is designated and accessible for official notices, and the virtual office operator can show demonstrable local infrastructure. The Cámara de Comercio and DIAN may reject purely virtual addresses that lack signage, access, or actual business utility.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for standard 3PL warehouse functions; approximate 5% annual probability of unannounced on-site inspection by the Superintendencia de Sociedades or DIAN for VAT and commercial substance verification.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and homonimia certificate
Notarization of articles of incorporation and bylaws
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff (Superintendencia de Notariado y Registro)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of S.A.S. in the commercial registry and RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registry fee based on registration tariff and minimum fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence and drafting of corporate resolutions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border S.A.S. incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO final beneficiary filing preparation and submission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified public accountant or legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional hourly rate for DIAN Resolution 164 of 2021 compliance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Apostille office of foreign jurisdiction or Colombian Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document statutory or consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of corporate documents and bylaws

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Ley 1258 de 2008), Articles 1-6, 17-19, and 22 governing the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.); supplemented by the Colombian Commercial Code (Código de Comercio), Articles 98-106, 110, 372-374, and Decree 1074 of 2015 (regulatory decree); tax registration under E.T. Articles 555-1 and 555-2.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating the Registro Único Empresarial (RUE); oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades; tax enrollment at DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) with attached by-laws, filed for commercial registration in the Registro Único Empresarial (RUE).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for S.A.S.; at least one share must be subscribed, and at least one share's par value must be paid in at incorporation. In-kind contributions require an expert valuation. No escrow account requirement under Colombian law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporators hereby subscribe in full to the authorized share capital of the Company, Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.), the contributed amounts being acknowledged as paid into the corporate treasury and recorded in the register of shareholders. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the legal domicile and registered office are established at the address declared in the incorporation document, serving for all statutory and administrative notices. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed General Manager and legal representative, and [Name] as Secretary, each with the powers specified in the by-laws. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the legal representative is authorized to execute all company registrations, commercial enrollments, tax filings, and bank account-opening procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (RUES online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES web portal or attend the Chamber of Commerce window; request a name search ('certificado de homonimia') for up to three proposed corporate names; pay the nominal search tariff; retain the certificate of non-identical name, valid for 90 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name resembles an existing registration, submit alternative names immediately; a written reconsideration request may be filed with the Registry Office within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Private Incorporation Instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Duly signed among incorporators; no notary or lawyer mandatory for S.A.S. under Law 1258 of 2008 and Decree 1074 of 2015
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the by-laws and private incorporation document; include company name, corporate purpose covering ISIC 5210 warehousing/fulfillment kitting, authorized/subscribed/paid capital, duration, registered office address, board structure and legal representative powers; have all shareholders execute the document and acknowledge the paid-in capital.
required_dossiers: Capital payment receipt or in-kind contribution valuation report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective clauses are cured by executing a supplementary clarification document before the registry, which will be recorded as an attachment to the main instrument.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing (Registro Único Empresarial – RUE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File two copies of the executed private incorporation document, the RUE single business registration form, the name certificate, and payment of the registration tariff; the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal confirming legal capacity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registry rejection may be cured through the reposición remedy addressed to the Registrar within ten business days; correct the flagged omissions and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification (RUT) and NIT Enrollment at DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (online RUT module)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the pre-registration in DIAN's virtual RUT service using the commercial registry certificate; the system assigns the NIT and the business classification (responsabilidad). Obtain the final RUT copy with electronic code, and register the tax regime (generally régimen ordinario for S.A.S.).
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If data inconsistencies block the RUT, request correction at the DIAN 'puntos de contacto'; present the updated registry certificate to authenticate changes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio – Registry of Books Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month after incorporation, submit the corporate books — register of shareholders, minutes of shareholder and board meetings, and register of contributions — to the Chamber for stamping and registration; each book must be formatted in compliance with the Commercial Code and remain sealed.
required_dossiers: Corporate books (register of shareholders, minute books)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late sealing attracts a registry fine; request an extension and pay the late tariff; the books are sealed retroactively with a notation of the delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commerce and Use-of-Soil Registration (ICA Tax and Warehouse Operation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Treasury / Secretaría de Hacienda (e.g., Dirección Distrital de Impuestos de Bogotá) and local planning authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the economic activity with the municipal treasury for the Industria y Comercio (ICA) tax; file the declaration of the warehouse address; request the land-use certificate (uso del suelo) from the planning authority to confirm logistics/storage use is permitted for the physical site; obtain the municipal 'matrícula' for the establishment.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease contract or property title of the warehouse
Fire safety certificate for the premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal denials are appealable under the municipal tax code (recursos de reconsideración); correct the land-use application by presenting the lease and zoning compliance letters and re-file.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None mandatory — Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo (MinCIT) classifies ISIC 5210 as a storage/logistics activity; municipal zoning approval is the only locational requirement.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no manufacturing license required; certification may be voluntarily obtained under NTC-ISO 9001 or BASC for secure 3PL operations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and local Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category exempt from full EIA — warehousing and kitting fall under low environmental impact; only a hazardous waste generator registration (Registro de Generadores de Residuos) with the CAR may be required if waste is generated above threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Resolución 0631 de 2015 — wastewater discharge limits (pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 ≤ 60 mg/L, TSS ≤ 84 mg/L); Resolución 2254 de 2017 — air quality thresholds (PM2.5 50 µg/m³ daily, PM10 75 µg/m³ daily); Resolución 1407 de 2018 — hazardous waste manifest and storage compliance for batteries, oils and packaging residues.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety certificate per NFPA retrofitted standards) for the warehouse; structural load inspection under NRS-10 (Reglamento Colombiano de Construcción Sismo Resistente); ARL occupational clearance for racking, forklift and manual handling operations per Resolución 0312 de 2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Official transactional portal: www.dian.gov.co (MUISCA platform for electronic filings, RUT, and tax returns).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S. with non-resident shareholders: (1) Incorporate the S.A.S. before a Notary and register the deed with the Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile; (2) Enroll the company in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) via MUISCA, submitting the pre-RUT form to obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), which DIAN assigns automatically upon acceptance; (3) Obtain a digital signature certificate from an authorized certification entity (e.g., Certicámara) to sign electronic invoices and tax declarations; (4) Register the S.A.S. as a full VAT responsible party (responsable del régimen común) and complete the DIAN electronic invoicing activation (habilitación de la factura electrónica de venta) through an authorized software operator or owning platform; (5) Apply for exporter status in the RUT and, if physically handling outbound goods, obtain the customs authorization (autorización aduanera) required for a 3PL fulfillment warehouse.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — A S.A.S. is a standalone income tax taxpayer (impuesto sobre la renta, 35% statutory rate for tax year 2024 and subsequent years), an IVA responsible party, and a municipal Industry and Commerce Tax (ICA) subject. No pass-through or fiscal transparency election is recognized for a standard S.A.S.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not offer a US-style check-the-box election. Available elections include: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) under Law 2010/2019, available to a S.A.S. with annual gross revenues not exceeding COP 100,000 million, replacing income tax, ICA, and simplifying IVA; (ii) election to be taxed as a Colombian Holding Company (CHC) under Art. 772-1 E.T. (Law 2277/2022), which permits a 0% dividend withholding and exemption on qualified foreign-source income; (iii) the option for exporters to elect the documentation-based treatment of exported services to access the 0% IVA rate; (iv) transfer-pricing documentation elections (choose the simplified or comprehensive report threshold).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto al Valor Agregado / Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No numeric threshold is prescribed for corporations: VAT liability begins upon the first taxable act in the national territory, regardless of turnover. A de-minimis simplified regime exists exclusively for natural persons with annual gross income not exceeding 3,500 UVT (approximately COP 164.7 million for 2024) and is unavailable to a S.A.S., which is therefore always mandatorily registered as a responsable del régimen común.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Direct real-time clearance is mandatory. Every sale or service invoice must be issued in UBL 2.1 XML format containing a CUDE (Código Único de Documento Electrónico), generated with the taxpayer's DIAN-issued digital certificate, and transmitted to DIAN within a maximum pre-validation window of 10 minutes through the DIAN web service or an authorized technology operator. DIAN performs real-time validation, assigns the fiscal hash/digital stamp, and records the operation in the MUISCA central register. Exporters and 3PL companies must also transmit electronic payroll (nómina electrónica) and the electronic inward-freight documents (documento equivalente) applicable to foreign inbound cargo.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and qualifying exported services are taxed at 0% IVA (excluded with right to refund of input VAT), provided: (i) goods physically depart from the national customs territory, evidenced by an accepted DEX (Declaración de Exportación) and the actual dispatch from the kitting/fulfillment warehouse; (ii) for services, including fulfillment, kitting, and light assembly, the recipient must be a non-resident entity without a Colombian permanent establishment and the economic benefit of the service must be realized exclusively abroad, supported by a written export services contract (contrato de exportación) filed with DIAN; (iii) the service provider must be registered in the RUT as an exporter; and (iv) for physical shipments handled by the S.A.S. in a bonded or non-bonded warehouse, the customs formalities must be completed by the S.A.S. or its customs agent, with the commercial invoice, packing list, and transport document aligned. Input VAT embedded in raw materials, consumables, and logistics inputs is reclaimable through the periodic IVA return (Form 300) or through the refund process (Form 210) when a saldo a favor arises.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DEX (Declaración de Exportación) — electronic customs declaration accepted by DIAN
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical dispatch from the Colombian fulfillment center
Commercial Invoice (factura comercial) in Spanish or English issued by the S.A.S.
Packing List (lista de empaque) detailing kitted units, weights, and HS codes
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de cambio) issued by a Colombian authorized foreign-exchange intermediary, evidencing collection of export proceeds
Copy of the executed export services contract (for services/fulfillment contracts) and certificate of use of services abroad
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may disallow the refund and impose: (i) a 25% penalty on the improperly obtained refund (Art. 670 E.T.) plus default interest; (ii) a 100% penalty on the tax evaded for inexactitude or fraud (Art. 647 E.T.); (iii) an additional two-fold (200%) surcharge and loss of exporter status where documents are falsified, with criminal prosecution for aggravated tax evasion under Art. 402 Código Penal (between 4 and 9 years' imprisonment); (iv) administrative penalties for non-compliance with the foreign-exchange repatriation deadline (infracción cambiaria), including fines calculated on the un-repatriated sum and suspension of the exporter registration; and (v) retrospective clawback of VAT refunds for a limitation period of up to 5 years, extended in cases of criminal conduct, together with transfer-pricing adjustments if export prices materially deviate from the arm's length standard.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Mercantile Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal imposes daily interest and fines up to COP 10,000,000; continued non-compliance leads to temporary suspension and, after 6 months, administrative strike-off of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in April (exact date set by DIAN per NIT ending digit, generally April 10–22 for the prior fiscal year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly default interest and fine of 5% of tax due per month of delay, capped at 200%; repeat or intentional evasion triggers criminal liability and asset seizure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Financial Statements Filing (Estados Financieros) with Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 each year, after shareholder approval; the approved financial statements must be filed to the Chamber of Commerce as part of the mercantile renewal package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 4% of the value of the registration; failure to file together with renewal prevents registry renewal and triggers same penalty regime as non-renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Owner Annual Confirmation (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before June 30, or within 30 days after any shareholding change, whichever is earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate submission is fined up to 1,500 UVT (approx. USD 20,000); false data may trigger corporate dissolution procedures and liability for management.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Revisor Fiscal (statutory independent auditor) is mandatory if total revenue or gross assets exceed 5,000 legal monthly minimum wages (SMMLV ~ COP 6,000,000,000 in 2024) or if the company's articles of incorporation require it; a smaller SAS is not legally required to have an audit unless its bylaws or supervisory body imposes one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: COLGAAP (Colombian Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) aligned to IFRS; institutions classified as 'Grupo 2' (SMEs) apply simplified IFRS, while smaller SAS use the corresponding simplified framework under Decree 2420/2015.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must confirm its ultimate beneficial owners annually via the DIAN RUB platform. Any share transfer must be recorded in the shareholder register and an amended RUB filed within 30 days of the transfer. The annual confirmation also serves as a declaration that the register of members reflects all current shareholdings. Failure to confirm triggers fines and possible dissolutions for non-operational companies.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory 35% corporate income tax for tax year 2024. No material sectoral incentive applies to ISIC 5210 fulfillment, kitting, or 3PL logistics operations. A reduced 20% rate may apply to new industrial or commercial entities established within a Zona Franca and providing logistics services, subject to employment, investment, and export requirements. No other general deductions materially lower the initial headline rate for this ordinary Colombian SAS.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) filed via DIAN’s electronic filing portal (Módulo DIAN / Declaración de Renta). Electronic signature or DIAN-issued credentials mandatory.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the 9th business day of the ninth month after the fiscal year-end for NIT ending in 0 or 1, with later dates up to the 21st business day for higher NIT endings. The Colombian fiscal year is the calendar year. Deadlines are published annually via DIAN Resolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and taxpayer name.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Colombian SAS NIT; do not substitute the foreign parent's tax ID.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross operating income from warehousing, kitting, packaging, and assembly services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include full Colombian-source revenue; if the SAS is a permanent establishment of a foreign parent, attribute only PE revenue. Otherwise report worldwide income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net cost of sales and services rendered.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only direct procurement, labor, and logistics costs supported by invoices and TP-compliant intercompany pricing.
Intercompany management fees, IT charges, and rent must be arm's length and economically substantiated.
Do not deduct dividends, foreign taxes not actually paid, or treaty-protected items without documentation.
Must reconcile with financial statements and TP adjustments.
Colombian tax losses may be carried forward up to 5 years. Foreign parent losses are not available.
Apply 35% to the final taxable base and compute foreign tax credits only where a DTA or domestic unilateral credit applies.
Any client withholdings or self-withholdings must reconcile with Formulario 350 and the annual withholding certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance due or balance in favor.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a refund is claimed, the non-resident must maintain originals or apostilled copies of supporting documents for up to 5 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax payable, minimum of 10 UVT and maximum of 1,000 UVT plus default interest. Late payment: interest of approximately 1.5% per month or more as set by DIAN. Inaccurate or omitted income: penalty of 20% to 160% of the omitted tax amount. Failure to file after persistent court orders: administrative liquidation by DIAN and criminal liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 7.5% on dividends paid from profits already taxed at the corporate level. A 35% withholding tax applies to distributions out of untaxed profits, plus a 3% remittance surcharge where applicable. In practice, properly taxed profits attract only the 7.5% WHT at dividend distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply treaty relief, the non-resident beneficiary must: (i) be a resident of the treaty country for tax purposes, (ii) obtain an original Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority, and (iii) submit it to the Colombian payer before payment, or at least no later than the deadline for the relevant tax return period. The payer files a reduced-withholding request via the DIAN portal, retains the TRC, an apostilled copy, and a declaration of beneficial ownership on file. If withholding was made at the statutory rate, the non-resident may claim a refund with the year-end Formulario 110 or via the special 'devolución de retención' application within 3 years, accompanied by the same documentation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid to foreign financial institutions is generally subject to 15% statutory WHT, but a reduced 5% rate applies to short-term external loans and certain financial entities. Royalties paid to foreign licensors are subject to 20% WHT (plus possible 10% surcharge if payable to related parties for the use of software or intangibles). Under most Colombian DTAs, interest WHT is reduced to 0%-10% and royalty WHT to 0%-10% where the beneficiary is the true beneficial owner.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Approx. COP 2.1 billion (45,000 UVT) in intercompany transactions with foreign related parties triggers mandatory Local File and Transfer Pricing return filing. Master File also required when multinational group consolidated revenue exceeds approx. 100,000 UVT (approx. COP 4.7 billion).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia applies the OECD-aligned economic substance principles through general anti-avoidance rules (GAAR) and the substance-over-form doctrine in the Colombia Tax Code (Article 869 et seq.). The SAS must maintain real physical presence, operational staff, inventory control, local decision-making, and sufficient capital relative to the logistics functions performed. A profit allocation of at least a routine return on warehouse/fulfilment functions is expected.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately under-reporting invoiced revenue from kitting and assembly services, manipulating inventory records, or issuing false electronic invoices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 4 to 9 years under Article 434A of the Colombian Criminal Code. Administrative fine of 20% to 160% of the omitted tax plus default interest. Seizure of bank accounts and goods.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives and accountant-directors are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax when fraudulent conduct is proven; they may face pre-trial detention, travel bans, asset freezing, and criminal imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging or paying non-arm's length prices for procurement, warehousing, management fees, or assembly services between the Colombian SAS and foreign related parties; failure to file the TP return or Local File when thresholds are exceeded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax adjustment of COP amount denied as a deduction; penalty of 20% to 160% of the understated tax; specific TP penalty of up to 3% of the unadjusted transaction value or 150-1,500 UVT depending on the seriousness.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign TP documentation with false information or who knowingly ignore comparable benchmarks may be personally liable to the extent of the resulting tax, and may be barred from corporate management for up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating the Colombian SAS without actual employees, warehouse, inventory, or logistics activity and routing profits through the SAS only to invoice or hold assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Total disregard of the entity for tax purposes, reattribution of income to the foreign parent, 35% tax on the deemed Colombian PE, and a 7.5% dividend WHT on any distribution. The underlying corporate registration may be canceled by the DIAN.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held civilly liable to third parties and the tax authority for the liabilities of the sham vehicle, with personal asset exposure and potential criminal charges for fraudulent misrepresentation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the 3PL entity to move illicit cash or to conceal beneficial ownership of funds for non-resident clients through fake kitting and logistic contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering penalties of 10 to 30 years’ imprisonment and heavy fines equivalent to 10,000-50,000 SMMLV. Forced extinction of the company's assets and cancellation of the commercial registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally prosecuted for authorizing transactions with funds potentially derived from illicit activity; they face criminal sentences, fines, travel restrictions, and international extradition from treaty partners.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends to a non-resident shareholder without withholding the 7.5% statutory rate, or disguising dividends as reimbursements, loans, or service fees to avoid WHT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Colombian SAS is liable to pay the full undeclared WHT plus default interest and a 100% penalty of the missing amount. The foreign recipient may also lose treaty protection and face an additional 3% surcharge.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize the distribution without legal support are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid withholding sum and can face criminal sanctions for intentional evasion.
